name: swarmer
description: A universal swarm of specialist agents for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI and any tool that reads AGENTS.md and Agent Skills); this plugin is one of the ways to install it in Claude Code. Professionals and sub-professionals, eight convening strategies (single, fan-out, classic, jury and light jury, full, plenary, new expert, auto), local overrides, English and Italian.
